---
title: "EarningsStability_ConFed"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# JQI: Earnings Stability and Confidence in Government
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)
library(car)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jqi_gss <- readRDS(
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "gss_job_quality_primary_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Construct confidence measure
# ============================================================

jqi_confed <- jqi_gss %>%
  mutate(

    # confed:
    # 1 = Great deal
    # 2 = Only some
    # 3 = Very little
    #
    # Higher values = LESS confidence in government

    confidence_government = case_when(
      as.numeric(confed) %in% 1:3 ~
        as.numeric(confed),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )

  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(confidence_government),
    !is.na(earnings_stability),
    !is.na(compensation),
    !is.na(benefits)
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Descriptive statistics
# ============================================================

nrow(jqi_confed)

jqi_confed %>%
  count(year)

jqi_confed %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_confidence = mean(
      confidence_government,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_earnings_stability = mean(
      earnings_stability,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 4. Basic relationship
# ============================================================

m_confed_earnings <- lm(
  confidence_government ~
    earnings_stability,
  data = jqi_confed
)

summary(m_confed_earnings)


# ============================================================
# 5. Joint JQI model
# ============================================================

m_confed_jqi <- lm(
  confidence_government ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability,
  data = jqi_confed
)

summary(m_confed_jqi)

vif(m_confed_jqi)


# ============================================================
# 6. Race × earnings stability
# ============================================================

jqi_confed_race <- jqi_confed %>%
  mutate(
    race_group = case_when(
      racecen1 == 1 ~ "White",
      racecen1 == 2 ~ "Black",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    race_group = factor(
      race_group,
      levels = c("White", "Black")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(race_group))


m_confed_earnings_race <- lm(
  confidence_government ~
    earnings_stability * race_group,
  data = jqi_confed_race
)

summary(m_confed_earnings_race)


# ============================================================
# 7. Fully joint race × JQI model
# ============================================================

m_confed_jqi_race <- lm(
  confidence_government ~
    compensation * race_group +
    benefits * race_group +
    earnings_stability * race_group,
  data = jqi_confed_race
)

summary(m_confed_jqi_race)


# ============================================================
# 8. Test racial difference in earnings-stability association
# ============================================================

linearHypothesis(
  m_confed_jqi_race,
  "race_groupBlack:earnings_stability = 0"
)


# ============================================================
# 9. Test all three racial differences jointly
# ============================================================

linearHypothesis(
  m_confed_jqi_race,
  c(
    "compensation:race_groupBlack = 0",
    "race_groupBlack:benefits = 0",
    "race_groupBlack:earnings_stability = 0"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 10. Implied slopes
# ============================================================

coef_confed <- coef(m_confed_jqi_race)

confed_slopes <- tibble(
  race = c("White", "Black"),
  earnings_stability_slope = c(

    coef_confed[
      "earnings_stability"
    ],

    coef_confed[
      "earnings_stability"
    ] +
      coef_confed[
        "race_groupBlack:earnings_stability"
      ]

  )
)

print(confed_slopes)


m_confed_time_restricted <- lm(
  confidence_government ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability +
    factor(year),
  data = jqi_confed
)

m_confed_time_full <- lm(
  confidence_government ~
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = jqi_confed
)

anova(
  m_confed_time_restricted,
  m_confed_time_full
)


m_confed_earnings_time_restricted <- lm(
  confidence_government ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability +
    factor(year) +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year),
  data = jqi_confed
)

m_confed_earnings_time_full <- lm(
  confidence_government ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability +
    factor(year) +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = jqi_confed
)

anova(
  m_confed_earnings_time_restricted,
  m_confed_earnings_time_full
)
# ============================================================
# 11. Save results
# ============================================================

write_csv(
  confed_slopes,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_EarningsStability_ConfidenceGovernment_Race.csv"
  )
)
```
